title: Story-pocket targets (pre-registered)
description: The sidecar tools/showcase-scoreboard.mjs scores each locality scenario against: per species a role, an occurrence band and a size target, per scenario a story frequency. Written by tools/story-pocket-targets.mjs --write; checked at load by validateSidecar (tools/story-pocket-lib.mjs), which enforces the cross-field rules this schema cannot express (exactly one primary per scored scenario; quantiles in order; a band and a size target each carry their basis or provenance). Every object is closed (additionalProperties false), so a new field must be documented here; tests-js/story-pocket-scoreboard.test.ts validates the committed sidecar against this schema.

inputs.description: The files the targets were built from, with hashes where they are not committed.

rules.description: The design rules (proposed; awaiting the boss). Each number has a basis field beside it.

occurrence.description: What counts as the species occurring in a run.

occurrence_bands.description: Literature abundance class → [lowest, highest] share of story pockets the species occurs in.

visible_mm.description: The review's 'visible' size, a reporting convention (clutter, the dust flag); it decides no verdict.

specimen_min_mm.description: Specimen lengths below it are set aside (micromount captions).

uploaded_together_s.description: Photographs whose image ids (read as upload seconds) differ by less than this were uploaded together.

uploaded_together_basis.description: Generated from the capture's image ids.

series_gap_s.description: A series' uploads follow each other by less than this.

display_range.description: The record's quantiles that bound its display scale; the scoreboard requires [0.25, 0.9].

named_signatures.description: Where no source votes: the collectibles the sources name, with the reason.

overrides.description: Hand decisions per scenario and species, each with its reason (why).

summary.description: A sample's count and quantiles (n alone when empty).

out_of_scope.description: Why the whole scenario is not scored, or null.

set_aside.description: Species outside the scenario's scope, with the reason; they get no role.

engine.description: Whether the simulator has an engine for it (data/minerals.json).

record_share.description: Its share of the locality's record (photographs and listings); null where the record is thin.

override.description: The reason, where a hand decision replaced the rule.

basis.description: crystal: photographed crystal lengths; specimen-proxy: photographed specimen dimensions, an upper bound on the crystal; unknown: too few of either.

series.description: The largest series among the crystal lengths (rules.series): its size, the sample's, its wording and the days from its first upload to its last.

without_largest_series.description: The crystal sample without its largest series, where that series has two or more lengths.

specimens.description: The photographs once those of one specimen are joined.

crystal.description: The crystal sample, also where it is too small to be the target.
